notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (Integrated Annual Report FY 2026). Method follows the pilot (_pilot.json), where Biocon's own 'economic value distributed' cross-check matched within 0.5%. Ind AS consolidated cash-flow statement: income taxes paid sit in operating (not added); interest paid sits in financing (added); interest received (1,480) is in investing, so no interest/dividend income inflates OCF. Revenue is revenue from operations; other income (3,425) is excluded. Excise not applicable. OCF fell to 19,940 from 40,612 in FY25, mainly on working capital (inventories −9,178, other assets −6,471).
